one_liner: A multiplayer UI that shows a color cue; players must jump onto the matching block in time, with increasing speed and difficulty.
primary_use_case: Multiplayer minigame UI for a Simon‑Says‑style color‑matching challenge.
preview_recommendation: The provided MP4 preview shows the UI and color cues clearly; recommend adding an audio preview to demonstrate the planned sound feedback.
manifest_quality_notes: Includes a GLB model, script, and four audio tracks (~25 MB total).
UI configurable via props (title, colors, scales).
Server‑client state sync using app.send/app.on (networked events).
Color channel integration may need debugging (local console reference).
Audio feedback not yet implemented in the script.
No explicit safety or physics logic present.
